exposure: Disease type (Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis)
disease activity during the third trimester
outcome: Postpartum flare of inflammatory bowel disease
cohort: 206 Women with inflammatory bowel disease who underwent successful pregnancy and live birth
finding: One-third of women with inflammatory bowel disease experienced a postpartum disease flare within a year after delivery, and this was predicted by disease activity during the third trimester, therapy de-escalation during pregnancy, and therapy de-escalation after pregnancy.
mod_finding: Postpartum disease flare was not related to mode of childbirth.
